name: kettlebell two arm clean
description: Clean two kettlebells from between the legs into a double rack position, using hip drive rather than pulling with the arms.
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell in each hand and your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and swing both bells back between your legs while keeping your back neutral.
Drive through your hips and guide both bells close to your body into the rack position at your shoulders.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows close, then lower or swing the bells back to reset.
